propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that, in any calendar year, the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding does not exceed 170kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
propositions.subject: The occupier of a holding
propositions.rule: must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied does not exceed 170kg per hectare
propositions.object: nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding
conditions: whether applied directly by an animal or by spreading
propositions.evidence_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that, in any calendar year, the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding, whether directly by an animal or by spreading, does not exceed 170kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.

propositions.proposition_text: Paragraph (1) does not apply where the occupier has been granted a derogation.
propositions.subject: Paragraph (1)
propositions.object: where the occupier has been granted a derogation
conditions: the occupier has been granted a derogation
propositions.evidence_text: Paragraph (1) does not apply where the occupier has been granted a derogation.

propositions.proposition_text: For the purposes of this regulation, the amount of nitrogen is to be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1.
propositions.subject: the amount of nitrogen
propositions.rule: is to be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1
propositions.evidence_text: the amount of nitrogen is to be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1
